NOTE 1:

Access for the purpose of NAS signaling connection recovery during an ongoing service as defined in subclause 4.5.3, or for the purpose of NAS signaling procedure recovery during an ongoing service as defined in subclause 4.5.3, and the service of NAS signaling procedure to be recovered is specified in rule # corresponding to that service, then that rule # applies.
NOTE 2:

Access for the purpose of NAS signaling connection recovery during an ongoing MO SMS procedure as defined in subclause 4.5.3, or for the purpose of NAS signaling procedure recovery during an ongoing MO SMS procedure as defined in subclause 4.5.3, and the corresponding standardized Access Category is the access category which is being used for the recovery of the ongoing MO SMS procedure and not category of the NAS SMS signaling procedure which is in order to allow as RRC establishment cause for the access attempt.
NOTE 3:
Access category 2 is for operator defined signalling and associated with the RRC establishment cause MO signalling.
NOTE 4:
This includes the SNPN connection management procedures triggered by the UE initiated NAS procedure for emergency services for the MO call.
NOTE 5:

This is the procedure of performing access category check for MO data (see TS 23.501), where when the UE is allowed for the access category 32 the operator defined category check shall not be applied. If an access category from 1 to 31 is configured and applies, the access category of the lowest [as defined] numbered access category or the lowest numbered access category as the lowest (ie UE part of it) is used. The UE shall use the applicable access category rule to derive an RRC establishment cause for the access attempt.
NOTE 6:

Access for SMS/IP over IMS or SMS over NAS (see 3GPP TS 23.501). The categories associated with access category 7 are defined from the service requirement perspective per EAB rules over TS 22.011 [11A].
NOTE 7:

NAS signaling procedure recovery during ongoing service as defined in subclause 4.5.3 is allowed, and the corresponding standardized Access Category is the access category (if any) which was used when initiating a mobile originated signalling procedure towards the PCF.
NOTE 8:
The SNPN connection management procedure triggered by (i) above; and
NOTE 9:

NAS signaling procedure recovery during an ongoing SMSoIP over MMTEL Vidio defined in subclause 4.5.3 is allowed. The access category for initiating a mobile originated signalling procedure towards the PCF.
NOTE 10:
Standardized Access Categories applicable to Access only and not associated with service as specified in TS 23.501.
NOTE 11:
The term 'non-3GPP' access refers to the case when the UE is accessing SNPN services via a non-3GPP access type.
